};

const safe=n=>n<=BigInt(Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER)?Number(n):n;

function pv(bytes,pos){
  let n=0n,shift=0n,i=pos;
  while(i<bytes.length){

    shift+=7n;
    if(shift>70n)throw Error('Invalid varint');
  }
  throw Error('Truncated varint');
}
